verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing's spending controls document blocking merchant categories, merchant IDs and countries, along with per-authorization limits, which covers the MCC blocklist part of the story. The evidence does not show MCC allowlists or locking a card to a single merchant; the real-time authorization webhook is only a building block for writing custom logic, not a built-in control. Missing for 10: documented MCC allowlists, single-merchant lock capability, explicit confirmation that controls are enforced at authorization time, independent or hands-on corroboration.
